question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**planet**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses events that have occurred "on our ______" throughout human history. This implies a global scale, referring to the Earth as a whole.
 
• "**planet**" is the most appropriate word to refer to the Earth
